newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo Truck to open factory in Tunisia.
newsitem.headline: Volvo Truck to open factory in Tunisia.

text.p: The truck division of Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Thursday that it was opening an assembly factory in Tunisia.
Volvo said in a statement that the factory was a cooperation between Volvo, Tunisian truck maker Setcar and Magrimex that distributes Volvo trucks in Tunisia.
Volvo said it would involve an investment of about five million crowns.
The factory was estimated to produce 300 trucks a year once it reached full production.
Volvo said the total market for trucks in Tunisia was currently about 600 trucks a year but this was expected to increase to 800 a year by the year 2000.
